messages:
frank: Quick review pls  opened a PR to clarify the Audit Export playbook (CMK example + small CLI flag rename). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4120. Can docs/legal glance?

docs-bot: PR created: frank/audit-export-cmk-playbook (#4120)  build queued.

yana: Scanning. CLI nit: the example uses `--tenant` which is deprecated. Replace with `--scope customer` (or `account`). Also dont use raw IDs in examples.

frank: Good catch. I'll switch to `--scope customer` and use `--customer-id cust-xxxx` placeholder.

yana: Example suggestion:

```bash
redwoodctl export-evidence --scope customer --customer-id cust-xxxx \
  --start 2026-01-01 --end 2026-01-31 --output ./evidence.jsonl
```

priya: Legal note: avoid absolute deletion language. Change any "we delete after X days" to neutral phrasing like "records are retained for up to 90 days unless otherwise required by contract or legal hold."

legal-ops: Confirmed. Also add one-line auditor checklist: output format (JSONL), headers present, fields that may contain PII (documented), and CMK guidance: "If you supply a customer-managed KMS key, ensure the key policy permits export decryption."

frank: Will add the checklist and a short CMK example. For CMK snippet I'll use a placeholder ARN (no real ARNs).

yana: Also redact PII in sample JSONL. Example row should use placeholders e.g.:

```jsonl
{"event_time":"2026-01-01T12:00:00Z","user_id":"cust-xxxx","action":"login","meta":"<redacted>"}
```

priya: Add a troubleshooting bullet for common error `export: forbidden` recommending verifying the `audit_exporter` role binding and that the service principal has KMS decrypt when CMK is used.

frank: Will push edits now and tag @legal-ops once CI passes.

docs-bot: CI passed for PR #4120  doc build OK.

legal-ops: Reviewed and approved. Keep the neutral retention phrasing and the auditor checklist.

frank: Merged. Thanks all! :tada:
